## Load Libraries

```{r load-libraries}
rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(DESeq2)
library(sva)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)

# Source custom functions
source("transcriptomics_functions.R")

out_dir = "./export/"
```

```{r load-data-models, eval=FALSE}
# Step 1: Load data
data_list <- load_transcriptomics_data(
  counts_path = './data/count_data_all.csv',
  metadata_path = "./data/metadata_ecphage.xlsx",
  annotation_path = "./data/22ET500456__with-ecolik12.csv",
  metadata_filter_col = "comment",
  metadata_filter_pattern = "missing",
  fname_col = "fname"
)

counts <- data_list$counts
metadata <- data_list$metadata
annotation <- data_list$annotation

#Step 2: remove 8 mg/L samples across times
keep_samples <- metadata %>% filter(ab_conc!=8) %>% pull(fname)
metadata_filt <- metadata %>% filter(fname %in% keep_samples)
counts_filt <- counts[,metadata_filt$fname]
metadata_filt$ab_conc <- droplevels(metadata_filt$ab_conc)
```


```{r load-data-models, eval=FALSE}
for (t in c("1h","4h","24h")){
  
  message(paste("--Identifying DEGs for: ", t))
  deseq_results <- run_DESeq2_sva(counts_filt, metadata_filt,formula_str = "~ ab_conc * phage", 
                             time_point = t)
   run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "ab_conc_4_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(out_dir,"venn_degs_",t,"_phage0-ab4.csv"),LFC=1,padj = 0.05)
   run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "phage_1_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(out_dir,"venn_degs_",t,"_phage1-ab0.csv"), LFC=1,padj = 0.05)
  
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "ab_conc_4_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(out_dir,"all_genes_",t,"_phage0-ab4.csv"))
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "phage_1_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(out_dir,"all_genes_",t,"_phage1-ab0.csv"))
  
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "ab_conc4.phage1", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(out_dir,"/interaction/all_genes_",t,"_abconc4.phage1.csv"))
      
}

```

## enriched KEGG

```{r}
#saves the file in export
run_gsea_venn("./export/")
 
```



```{r}
library(patchwork)
source("transcriptomics_functions.R")

pvenn_res <- plot_venn_diagram('./export/')
write.csv(pvenn_res$count,"./export/count_venn_diagram.csv")
ppcoa_res <- plot_pcoa(counts_filt,metadata_filt)

gsea_all <- read.csv('./export/gsea_all_venn.csv')
pgsea <- plot_pathway_dotplot(gsea_all)

pgsea <- pgsea + theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 1.06))
ppcoa <- ppcoa_res$fig+ theme(legend.position="top")

p<- ( ppcoa /  pvenn_res$fig) + plot_layout(heights = c(0.8, 1.2),widths = c(0.5,1.5))
(p|pgsea) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.4, .6)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

ggsave('./figures/pcoa_venn_dotplot.pdf',device='pdf',height = 10,width = 12)
```



## combo vs mono therapy
```{r}

df_response <- assess_interactions(in_dir="./export/interaction/",
                                  out_dir = "./export/interaction/",
                                   annotation = annotation)

```

```{r}

library(patchwork)



gene_cat_df <- read.csv('./data/gene_category.csv')
pap <- plot_lfc_chicklets(df_response$data,
                   response_class = "Antibiotic-amplified-by-phage",
                   gene_category = gene_cat_df)


pcom <- plot_lfc_chicklets(df_response$data,
                   response_class = "Combination-specific",
                  filter_col = c("time_point","gene",'lfc_phage',"lfc_ab","lfc_interaction","gene_name"),
                   gene_category = gene_cat_df)

ppa <- plot_lfc_chicklets(df_response$data,
                   response_class = "Phage-modified-by-antibiotic",
                  filter_col = c("time_point","gene",'lfc_phage',"lfc_interaction","gene_name"),
                   gene_category = gene_cat_df)

p0 <- (pcom / ppa) + plot_layout(heights = c(0.9,1.1))
p <- (pap | p0) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') 

p  +  plot_layout(guides = 'collect') & theme(legend.position = 'bottom')


ggsave("./figures/response_classes_3.pdf",device = "pdf", width = 12,height = 10)
```
